atoms.name: Shape: complete tree
atoms.one_line: Height floor(log2 n). Leaves are indices floor(n/2)+1 to n.

atoms.name: Insert (sift up)
atoms.one_line: Add at the end, swap with the parent while it breaks the rule. O(log n).

atoms.name: Delete and extract (sift down)
atoms.one_line: Move the last item to the root, swap with the larger child. O(log n).

atoms.name: Build-heap (Floyd)
atoms.one_line: Sift down from index floor(n/2) to 1. Total Θ(n), not n log n.

atoms.name: Where extremes live
atoms.one_line: Max-heap: min is at a leaf. Min-heap: max is at a leaf. Finding it costs Θ(n).

atoms.name: Counting heaps
atoms.one_line: Choose which keys go left: C(n-1, L) x h(L) x h(R).

atoms.name: Priority queue and heapsort
atoms.one_line: find-max O(1), insert and extract O(log n), heapsort Θ(n log n), top-k with a size-k heap.

atoms.name: Python heapq
atoms.one_line: heapq is a min-heap on a list. heappush, heappop, heapify (O(n)).

patterns.name: Build-heap or insert trace on an array
